title: O virginum praeclara (Gaspar, Motet cycle Ave mundi domina)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Motet cycle Ave mundi domina, O virginum praeclara. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0301g), edited by Agnese Pavanello (MCE 5: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Ave mundi domina, 2021); encoded by Craig Stuart Sapp. CC BY-NC 4.0.
